name: Sinodendron rugosum
intro: I tested two laying substrates, decaying logs and flake soil.

sections.title: Breeding trial
sections.text: Females bored into the logs. I found neither eggs nor larvae in either substrate. The adults appeared to feed while excavating, although I could not confirm ingestion. For another trial I would use decaying alder. Furniss and colleagues recorded adults emerging from alder collected at Sheep Creek, Idaho.

facts.title: Outcome
facts.text: No larvae recovered in either setup
